note: No data was downloaded for this study: the fix reads only inputs the campaign already committed, and the re-screen runs the same battery as bank_v3. files[] pins the inputs the re-screened arms and the engine read (SHA-256 computed in this worktree); the framework's own research/batch_screen/DATA_MANIFEST.json pins the full input set (31 extra series + the OOS/ETF files) and `python -m research.batch_screen.extra --verify` re-hashes every extra series. The parity archive inputs are the engine's own committed battery (research/fast_engine/PARITY.json's data), unchanged.

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dai.role: QQQ / QLD* / SPY bars -- the main window and every clean/fresh bootstrap chunk (the SPY column builds the IC40 2x_spy leg)

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dtb.role: DTB3 -- the leg's financing (the 2x recurrence's rate column)

data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_usdtry_c.role: USDTRY -- the after-tax stages' currency conversion (the Stage-1 after-tax cell)

data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_yiufe.cs.role: Yi-UFE -- the Turkish tax indexation (the after-tax stages)

data/historical/plugins_d1_lqd.csv.role: LQD adjusted close -- IC31's off-state leg (extra key `lqd`)

data/historical/plugins_d1_gdx.csv.role: GDX adjusted close -- IC35's off-state leg (extra key `gdx`)

artifacts.research/opts_nan_fix_v1/PRE_FIX_BASELIN: the pre-fix bootstrap archive (85 cells, raw float64 per-path CAGRs) the parity diff is taken against; its SHA-256 is recorded in PARITY_FIX.json (the file is a zip, so its bytes are not reproducible, only its arrays are)
artifacts.research/opts_nan_fix_v1/HARNESS.json: the study harness (engine parity --quick, engine anchors, chunk-leg stats, parity diff)

parity_cells.note: small path counts (2-8) -- the parity cell is about bit-identity, not sampling
